title: [PlayFab Matchmaking] cancel_async hangs when a ticket matches first; terminal failures lose the native HRESULT
body:
Found during testing and validation of Quick Match in the NetRumble Godot game
(microsoft/XBOX-Godot-NetRumble#17), against `main` @ `b1b4e0b`.

Both bugs share one root cause: the addon treats a terminal `TicketStatusChanged` as the end of a
ticket's life. The SDK's terminal event is `TicketCompleted`, which carries the outcome HRESULT, and
the ticket should be destroyed only after it
([Matchmaking SDK quickstart](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xbox/playfab/multiplayer/matchmaking/quickstart-client-sdk)).

## 1. `cancel_async()` never completes if the ticket matches first

A ticket can match before its cancellation is processed. `TicketCompleted` then settles the pending
cancel only for cancelled/failed outcomes (`playfab_multiplayer.cpp:3512`) and destroys the ticket
(`:3530`), so the awaiting coroutine never resumes.

**Expected:** a pending cancel completes on every terminal outcome, before the ticket is destroyed.
A matched ticket returns `ok == false` with a distinct lost-race code and keeps its final status and
match details readable.

## 2. Terminal failures lose the native HRESULT

A terminal `TicketStatusChanged` reports a synthesized `E_FAIL` (`:3473`) and destroys the ticket at
the end of the batch, so a later `TicketCompleted` can no longer deliver the real HRESULT (`:3504`).
Create failures without a ticket id also substitute `E_FAIL` (`:1927`).

**Expected:** create, join, and tracked-ticket failures surface the native HRESULT (for example
`E_PF_MATCHMAKING_NUMBER_OF_PLAYERS_IN_TICKET_TOO_LARGE`, `0x89235652`), with no earlier `E_FAIL`
notification. Document that `PlayFabResult.hresult` is a sign-extended int64.

## Acceptance

- Offline tests drive the native dispatcher through each ordering: cancel vs. match, status vs.
  completion in the same and separate batches, duplicate cancels, cancel-start failure, and
  shutdown with a cancel pending. Every completion fires exactly once.
- `cancel_async` and `PlayFabResult.hresult` docs updated.
